structured.answer: Na podstawie dostarczonych dokumentów nie da się wskazać, kto spełnia wszystkie wymagania **RFP-002** i jest dostępny przed startem projektu, ponieważ w dokumentach nie ma treści ani listy wymagań **RFP-002** oraz brak informacji o dacie startu projektu.

cypher:
MATCH (r:RFP {id:'RFP-002'})
MATCH (r)-[:REQUIRES {min_years: rmin}]->(req:Skill)
WITH r, req, rmin
MATCH (p:Person)-[h:HAS_SKILL]->(req)
WHERE h.years >= rmin
WITH r, p, collect({skill:req.name, min_years:rmin}) AS reqs
MATCH (r)-[:REQUIRES]->(req2:Skill)
WITH r, p, reqs, collect(DISTINCT req2.name) AS reqNames
WHERE size(reqNames) = size(reqs)
  AND size(reqs) = size(reqNames)
  AND all(x IN reqs WHERE x.skill IN reqNames)
WHERE p.available_from < r.start_date OR p.available_from = r.start_date
RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.title, p.available_from, r.start_date AS rfp_start_date, r.team_size

MATCH (r:RFP {id:'RFP-002'})-[:REQUIRES {min_years: rmin}]->(req:Skill)
WITH r, collect({skill:req.name, min_years:rmin}) AS required
MATCH (p:Person)-[h:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WITH r, required, p, collect({skill:s.name, years:h.years}) AS skills
WITH r, required, p
WHERE all(req IN required WHERE any(k IN skills WHERE k.skill = req.skill AND k.years >= req.min_years))
  AND p.available_from <= r.start_date
RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.title, p.available_from, r.start_date AS rfp_start_date, r.team_size AS team_size

MATCH (r:RFP {id:'RFP-002'})- [reqRel:REQUIRES]->(reqSkill:Skill)
WITH r, collect({skill:reqSkill.name, min_years:reqRel.min_years}) AS required
MATCH (p:Person)-[h:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WITH r, required, p, collect({skill:s.name, years:h.years}) AS skills
WITH r, required, p
WHERE all(req IN required WHERE any(k IN skills WHERE k.skill = req.skill AND k.years >= req.min_years))
  AND p.available_from <= r.start_date
RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.title, p.available_from, r.start_date AS rfp_start_date, r.team_size AS team_size
